projects.title: Dev Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- Developer Portfolio Website made in React
 -  Fully customisable and dynamic, easily change data and images.
 - Dark Mode Support

projects.title: Pocket Notes App
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a responsive web app for managing notes with timestamps.
 - Users can easily add, review, and organize notes by creation time.
 - Ensured seamless user experience across devices.

projects.title: AI Code Reviewer
projects.bodyText:
- Built an AI-powered code review platform using OpenAI Codex to analyze and provide smart code suggestions
- Integrated with React and FastAPI, achieving a 30% reduction in manual review time
- Utilized PostgreSQL for storing review feedback and code history across sessions

projects.title: AI-Powered LaTeX Resume Tailoring Engine
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow using LLMs, ChromaDB, vector embeddings, semantic search, and prompt engineering to tailor resumes to job descriptions while preserving ATS-compatible LaTeX formatting
- Implemented multi-model LLM orchestration with configurable output parameters to improve keyword alignment and relevance for applicant tracking systems
- Built a FastAPI backend with a real-time LaTeX compilation pipeline and PDF generation, enabling automated and scalable resume customization

projects.title: AI-Powered Customer Feedback Intelligence Platform
projects.bodyText:
- Built a RAG-based conversational analytics platform using LangChain with Chroma VectorDB, vector embeddings, and semantic search to enable natural-language querying of customer feedback
- Developed FastAPI microservices with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and ML inference pipelines to support real-time and batch sentiment analysis
- Implemented automated ingestion and processing pipelines using Redis queues, RQ workers, and PostgreSQL, reducing manual customer feedback analysis time by 50%

projects.title: AI_Assignment_Generator
projects.bodyText:
- Developed an AI-powered tool for auto-generating academic assignments.
 - Streamlined content creation with a clean, responsive UI for all devices.
